block.modularcraft.speaker: Amp
modularcraft.tool_help: Ports are on the lower front face. Right-click air to cancel.
modularcraft.port_hint: %s · Right-click to patch; Shift-right-click an input to remove.
modularcraft.gain_warning: Removing Gain In returns Amp to Drone or its built-in ADSR.
modularcraft.note.range: Below 20 Hz. Choose E0 or higher.
modularcraft.note.help: Sets manual frequency (A4 = 440 Hz). Connected Pitch In controls the sounding pitch.
modularcraft.note.menu_help: Up/Down selects; Home/End jumps; Enter confirms; Escape cancels. Tab moves to the next control.
modularcraft.keyboard_help: Piano: A W S E D F T G Y H U J. Left/right changes octave. Tab selects controls.
modularcraft.euclidean.fast_clock: Clock above 50 Hz ignored. Slow the source.
modularcraft.euclidean.legend: Filled: hit · Hollow: rest · White: playhead
modularcraft.mixer.solo_help: Listen to selected solos together. Mute takes precedence.
modularcraft.mixer.level_help: %s level: 0–100%. Drag to audition; arrows adjust by 1%.
modularcraft.mixer.inactive: Audio inactive · Enable a connected speaker and local audio.
modularcraft.error.amp_external: External Gain In overrides ADSR and Drone.
modularcraft.error.speaker_waiting: Waiting for playback capacity. Disable another patch or speaker.
modularcraft.error.speaker_suspended: Playback suspended. Reduce load, then re-enable this speaker.
modularcraft.error.mixer_timeout: No edit acknowledgment. Reopen the mixer to refresh its state.
modularcraft.error.lfo_sync: Clock synchronized · Hz is saved for disconnection.
modularcraft.error.lfo_waiting: Waiting for clock · phase held; start the sequencer.
modularcraft.error.sequencer_pattern: Hits must be 0–Steps; rotation must be 0–Steps−1.
modularcraft.error.sequencer_overload: Control timeline overload: reduce modulation/clock load, then restart sequencers and enable speakers.
modularcraft.error.keyboard_unavailable: Keyboard unavailable. Move within six blocks and reopen its panel.
modularcraft.error.midi_off: MIDI off. Select an input device to play.
modularcraft.error.midi_ready: MIDI connected. Exact pitch; sustain pedal supported.
modularcraft.error.midi_paused: MIDI paused. Return to the keyboard panel to play.
modularcraft.error.midi_missing: MIDI device missing. Connect it, then Refresh or select an input.
modularcraft.error.midi_ambiguous: Several MIDI inputs match. Select the intended device again.
modularcraft.error.midi_unavailable: MIDI input unavailable. Check the device, then Refresh.
modularcraft.error.midi_timeout: MIDI timed out. Refresh; if still unavailable, restart Minecraft.
modularcraft.error.keyboard_busy: Keyboard in use. Wait until the other player releases it.
modularcraft.error.keyboard_overload: Keyboard input overloaded. Close and reopen the panel.
modularcraft.error.pulse_pitch_connected: CV sets pitch; PWM sets pulse width.
modularcraft.error.pitch_connected: CV sets pitch; Detune adds unison spread.
modularcraft.error.permission: Only the owner or an operator within six blocks may edit. Move closer or ask the owner.
modularcraft.error.range: Use a finite value in the displayed range; stay within six blocks.
modularcraft.error.quarantined: Stored data is quarantined. Back up the world and restore it with a compatible version.
modularcraft.error.world_capacity: World limit: 256 modules / 512 cables. Remove an unused module or cable.
modularcraft.error.player_modules: Owner limit: 64 modules. Remove an unused module.
modularcraft.error.player_cables: Owner limit: 128 cables. Remove an unused cable.
modularcraft.error.patch_modules: Patch limit: 20 modules. Split the patch first.
modularcraft.error.patch_cables: Patch limit: 24 cables. Remove a cable first.
modularcraft.error.patch_speakers: Patch limit: two speakers. Disconnect a speaker first.
modularcraft.error.active_patches: World limit: four active patches. Disable another patch first.
modularcraft.error.active_speakers: World limit: eight enabled speakers. Disable one first.
modularcraft.error.patch_unloaded: Patch suspended: load all chunks, restart sequencers, and enable speakers.
modularcraft.error.unloaded: Endpoint unavailable. Load both modules and try again.
modularcraft.error.disabled: Speaker disabled. Enable it to play; restart and chunk unload disable speakers.
modularcraft.error.missing_audio: No audio input. Connect an Audio Out to Audio In.
modularcraft.error.released: Envelope released. Hold Gate or apply redstone power.
modularcraft.error.ready: Ready. Master, Records, local volume and distance affect what you hear.
modularcraft.error.awaiting: Waiting for the server to accept this value.
modularcraft.error.stale: This module changed. Review refreshed values and retry.
modularcraft.error.occupied_input: Input already connected. Shift-right-click that input to remove its cable first.
modularcraft.error.incompatible_ports: Match audio, control, or pitch ports. Gate/trigger/clock outputs connect to Gate, Clock, or Reset inputs.
modularcraft.error.different_owners: Both cable endpoints must have the same owner, including operator edits.
modularcraft.error.cycle: Feedback is unsupported. Remove the connection that would form a loop.
modularcraft.error.duplicate_cable: That cable already exists. Choose a free input.
modularcraft.error.fanout: Output limit: four destinations. Disconnect one first.
modularcraft.error.cable_distance: Cable limit: 16 blocks between centers. Move the modules closer.
modularcraft.error.dimension: Both endpoints must be in the same dimension.
modularcraft.error.missing_cable: That input has no cable to remove.
modularcraft.error.remove_at_input: Shift-right-click the destination input to remove one cable.
modularcraft.error.select_output: Select an output on the source module first.
modularcraft.error.cancelled: Cable selection cancelled. Select an output to start again.
modularcraft.error.connected: Cable connected. Select another output to continue.
modularcraft.error.removed: Cable removed. Other connections are unchanged.
modularcraft.error.gain_disconnected: Gain cable removed: Amp now uses Drone or its built-in ADSR.
modularcraft.error.gate_eligibility: Open the envelope panel nearby to hold its manual gate.
modularcraft.error.missing_module: Module no longer exists. Select its replacement explicitly.
modularcraft.error.not_speaker: Only Amplifier / Speaker modules can be enabled.
modularcraft.error.parameter: This control does not belong to this module.
modularcraft.error.parameters: Invalid control set. Refresh the module panel.
modularcraft.error.action: Unknown action. Reconnect with a compatible mod version.
modularcraft.error.invalid: Edit rejected. Refresh accepted state and try again.
modularcraft.error.identity_conflict: Conflicting saved identity. Back up and restore the affected module.
modularcraft.error.duplicate_identity: Duplicate saved identity. Restore the original module from backup.
modularcraft.error.occupied_position: A module already owns this position. Inspect or remove it first.
modularcraft.error.encoded_size: Storage limit reached. Back up and remove unused compositions.
modularcraft.error.record_count: Storage record limit reached. Recover quarantined records from backup.
modularcraft.error.muted: Local audio muted. Unmute here or use your configured mute key.
modularcraft.error.overload: Local playback overloaded and was silenced. Reduce load, then resynchronize.
modularcraft.error.device_recovery: Audio device unavailable. Select a working Minecraft device, then resynchronize.
modularcraft.error.resync: Synchronizing current sound. Missed notes will not be replayed.
modularcraft.error.revision_gap: Patch state incomplete. Requesting a current snapshot.
modularcraft.error.invalid_snapshot: Invalid patch snapshot. Reconnect using compatible mod versions.
modularcraft.error.reloading: Resources reloading. Playback will resume at the current musical position.
modularcraft.error.settings_read: Could not read local settings. Check the config file permissions.
modularcraft.error.settings_write: Could not save local settings. Check the config directory permissions.
modularcraft.error.throttled: Edit rate limited: 20/s per player, 200/s per world. Wait and retry refreshed values.
modularcraft.euclidean.redstone_help: Powered: resume. Unpowered: stop. Start/Stop are disabled; Reset remains available. Turning this off keeps the current playback state.
modularcraft.error.redstone_controlled: Redstone controls playback. Turn Redstone Mode off to use Start/Stop.
